export const useStudyWizardStore = create<StudyWizardStore>(set => ({
  isOpen: false,
  currentStep: 0,
  name: '',
  description: '',
  selectedBrand: null,
  selectedIndications: [],
  selectedPersonas: [],
  featureFlagOverrides: null,
  setFeatureFlagOverrides: overrides => set({ featureFlagOverrides: overrides }),
  setSelectedPersonas: personas => set({ selectedPersonas: personas }),
  setName: (name: string) => set({ name }),
  setDescription: (description: string) => set({ description }),
  setSelectedBrand: brand => set({ selectedBrand: brand }),
  setSelectedIndications: indications => set({ selectedIndications: indications }),
  setIsOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => set({ isOpen }),
  setCurrentStep: (step: number) => set({ currentStep: step }),
  start: () => set({ isOpen: true, currentStep: 0 }),
  cancel: () =>
    set({
      isOpen: false,
      currentStep: 0,
      name: '',
      description: '',
      selectedBrand: null,
      selectedIndications: [],
      selectedPersonas: [],
      featureFlagOverrides: null,
    }),
  goNext: () =>
    set(state => ({
      currentStep: state.currentStep < 5 ? state.currentStep + 1 : state.currentStep,
    })),
  goBack: () =>
    set(state => ({
      currentStep: state.currentStep > 0 ? state.currentStep - 1 : state.currentStep,
    })),
  finalize: () =>
    set({
      isOpen: false,
      currentStep: 0,
      name: '',
      description: '',
      selectedBrand: null,
      selectedIndications: [],
      selectedPersonas: [],
      featureFlagOverrides: null,
    }),
}));
